---
title: "15 · Mobility (origin-destination matrices)"
execute:
  enabled: false
---

`od_matrix_to_graph()` turns an origin-destination matrix into a directed,
weighted graph whose nodes are zones, polygons or points, and whose edges are
observed flows. Those edges presuppose no spatial relation at all, neither
proximity nor physical connection: they are measured interactions, possibly
asymmetric, and the asymmetry is information.

Both accepted formats are covered: `matrix_type="edgelist"`, one row per pair
with origin, destination and weight columns, starting from a 16-zone test grid
small enough to read the function's contract without noise; and
`matrix_type="adjacency"`, a square zones × zones matrix. The notebook also
notes that the `c2g_od_to_graph` operator does not propagate `od_source_col` and
`od_target_col`, always using `"source"` and `"target"`.

No network access needed.
